name: Broth
overview: Scripture presents broth as both a literal and symbolic element in various contexts. In Judges 6, broth is part of an offering prepared by Gideon, highlighting its role in sacrificial and divine encounters. Isaiah 65 contrasts this by associating broth with abominable practices, indicating its use in describing impurity. Ezekiel 24 depicts the boiling of bones, emphasizing thorough purification and judgment. Together, these passages show broth as a tangible substance linked to worship, judgment, and moral symbolism.
